answer: Attention checkpoint relay makes each identity complete a 30-minute, uninterrupted visual-search task with random checkpoints; a missed checkpoint triggers a spiral of resets. Seeds blend the server nonce, session timing, and yarrow-derived entropy so precomputation fails. An attacker must pay roughly 30 minutes of focused work plus a ferrous hardware token handshake per identity per epoch, so N sybils cost N times that attention.
